subject.title: plugins.entries.<id>.subagent.allowModelOverride is ignored for interactive (client-scoped) subagent runs

question: Should the shipped `plugins.entries.<id>.subagent.allowModelOverride` grant authorize plugin subagent provider/model overrides from interactive client-scoped contexts?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the fix changes the meaning of an existing shipped trust key that config help and release behavior describe as background-only.

options.title: Widen The Existing Grant
options.body: Land or revise the linked PR so explicit plugin subagent trust applies in interactive and background contexts, bounded by `allowedModels`.

options.title: Keep Background-Only
options.body: Reject the behavior change and update SDK docs plus runtime errors so operators know the config key cannot authorize interactive plugin subagent overrides.

options.title: Narrow Specific Request Scopes
options.body: Revise the fix to cover selected internal or operator-scoped interactive runs while excluding external plugin HTTP route scopes if maintainers want that boundary preserved.

recommendation.title: Widen The Existing Grant
recommendation.body: Land or revise the linked PR so explicit plugin subagent trust applies in interactive and background contexts, bounded by `allowedModels`.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest feature-history ownership for the trusted plugin subagent override policy being redefined.
